_comment: Single source of truth for per-route SEO. Read by scripts/assert-seo.mjs in this repo, and intended to be read by generateMetadata in rz-codes-next so the two implementations cannot drift. Gatsby is JS+react-helmet and Next is TS+Metadata API, so the component cannot be shared - the DATA is what gets shared.
